sentences.text: Finnish Sauna Shop Oy is a cohort company registered on 2025-03-08 under the industry code 47279, retail sale of other food.
The record shows three product launches, dated 2025-10-16, 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-13, and a first customer or pilot named on 2025-10-28.
A programme-entry record is dated 2026-02-09 and first sales are recorded on 2025-03-08.
No grant, EU project or contract record is on file, so technology and investment readiness are unknown and ocean impact cannot be read.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and the product activity is not yet tied to an ocean use in any public source.
